title: Four Freedoms Video
content: TheNorman Rockwell Museumhas produced a brief documentary telling the story of how Norman Rockwell interpreted Roosevelt's "Four Freedoms" speech into a series of paintings that defined the WWII war effort.Although inspired by the ideals of Roosevelt's speech, the lofty language stymied Rockwell at first. "It was so darned high blown," he said, "sometimes I couldn't get my mind around it." (Link to video on YouTube)
